description: Source file implementing directory handling functions for Windows platform, including path normalization, existence checks, and directory creation.

methods.name: HasValidHandle
methods.description: Checks if a given SbDirectory has a valid handle.

methods.name: TrimExtraFileSeparators
methods.description: Removes trailing file separator characters from a directory name.

methods.name: IsAbsolutePath
methods.description: Determines if a given path is an absolute path.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateDirectoryHierarchy
methods.description: Creates a directory hierarchy, creating parent directories as needed.

methods.name: DirectoryExistsOrCreated
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists or creates it if it does not.
